cohort: This study analysed non-anomalous, singleton, breech live births at 22 0/7 to 25 6/7 weeks of gestation identified in the linked birth-infant death records data from 2016 to 2021.
finding: Vaginal breech birth between 22 0/7 and 25 6/7 weeks of gestation is associated with a lower risk of adverse maternal outcomes but a higher risk of neonatal adverse outcomes and mortality.
mod_finding: Vaginal breech birth between 22 0/7 and 25 6/7 weeks of gestation is associated with a lower risk of adverse maternal outcomes but a higher risk of neonatal adverse outcomes and mortality compared to caesarean birth.
